_comment: codebase-xray config. policy maps pipeline phases to model tier aliases (opus|sonnet|haiku). Aliases resolve to canonical IDs via scripts/models.py, optionally overridden by a modelAliases object in this file (e.g. {"opus": "claude-opus-4-8"}). Set personas to a list of slugs to run a subset; null = all 14. components is the default component set when the user names none: 'core', 'all', or a list of slugs from {core, ui-inventory, sitemap, graphql, server, ai, redesign}.
